realm.name: tenant-admin
realm.description: Full admin over their own tenant: providers, agents, MCP registry, knowledge base, user management within the tenant.

realm.name: platform-admin
realm.description: Cross-tenant platform operator for the admin console. Not auto-granted at signup; assign manually to real platform-operator accounts only. Members of the platform-admins group below get MFA enforced - see keycloak/README.md for the one manual admin-console step this realm export can't express.

realm.name: agent-builder
realm.description: Can create/edit agents, attach knowledge bases and tools, but cannot manage billing or invite/remove other users.

realm.name: delegated-user
realm.description: Assisted/delegated-setup role - configuring an agent on behalf of a non-technical end user who never gets their own login.

realm.name: end-customer
realm.description: Scoped role for the customer-facing widget's public auth path - rate-limited, domain-restricted, no access to any admin endpoint.

clients.name: VegaDuta Core (Spring Boot resource server)
clients.description: Confidential client used by core's OAuth2 Resource Server config to validate tokens via the JWKS endpoint, and server-side for the Keycloak Admin REST API in tenant-provisioning.

clients.name: VegaDuta Web Console
clients.description: Public client (browser, no secret) for the Next.js console's OIDC authorization-code-with-PKCE login flow.

clients.name: VegaDuta Platform Admin Console
clients.description: Public client (browser, no secret) for web-admin's OIDC auth-code+PKCE flow. No tenant_id mapper: platform-admin ops are cross-tenant. Fronted additionally by Cloudflare Access (terraform/modules/cloudflare-access) as a pre-auth gate.
